channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: India Launches Free Nationwide HPV Vaccine Campaign to Protect 1.15 Crore Girls from Cervical Cancer
item.description: The government aims to reduce cervical cancer by providing free, single-dose HPV vaccines to 14-year-old girls nationwide.

item.title: Viral Video of Shivaji Maharaj Portrait Used as Washroom Sign Sparks National Outrage in Haryana
item.description: A viral clip allegedly showing portraits resembling Shivaji Maharaj and Rani Padmini used as restroom signage in a Faridabad banquet hall has sparked outrage, political reactions, and demands for accountability before the images were removed.

item.title: Arunachal CM Pema Khandu Slams ‘Shameful’ Racial Abuse of 3 Women in Delhi, Urges Immediate Arrest of Accused
item.description: A minor dispute over AC installation in Malviya Nagar escalated into alleged racial abuse of three Arunachal women, prompting an FIR, police investigation, and direct intervention by Chief Minister Pema Khandu.

item.title: From Purchase to Ownership: Mapping the Full Used Car Buyer Journey With The Best Used Car Platforms in India
item.description: Organised platforms like Cars24 are turning India's fraught used car market into a transparent, buyer-friendly journey with rigorous checks, fixed prices, and strong post-sale support.

item.title: Turkish Air Force F‑16 Crashes Near Bursa‑İzmir Highway; Pilot Martyred, Official Investigation Launched
item.description: A Turkish Air Force F‑16 crashed after takeoff from Balıkesir, killing the pilot; investigation launched.

item.title: UP Food Safety: Over 225 Kg of Suspected ‘Chemical’ Rasogolla Destroyed in Sambhal Ahead of Festive Season
item.description: Authorities in Sambhal destroyed 225 kg of suspected adulterated rasogolla during a statewide food safety drive ahead of the festive season, with samples sent for laboratory testing and legal action likely.

item.title: Jharkhand Air Ambulance Crash: All 7 On Board Killed, Bodies Handed Over to Family Members after Post-Mortem
item.description: A medical evacuation flight with a critically ill patient and six others crashed in Jharkhand, killing all onboard.

item.title: Dharwad Protest Erupts Over 2.6 Lakh Vacancies; Karnataka Promises 56,000 New Government Jobs
item.description: Hundreds protested in Dharwad over 2.6 lakh vacancies; Karnataka promised 56,000 jobs amid political tensions.

item.title: Rishabh Thakur, Externed Under Goonda Act, Arrested Over Alleged ₹40,000 Extortion Case
item.description: Bareilly Police arrested the previously externed accused over allegedly demanding ₹40,000 and harassing locals.

item.title: Massive Landslide Blocks Manikaran–Barshaini Road in Kullu district, Strands Travellers in Himachal Pradesh
item.description: A sudden landslide in Kullu district blocked the Manikaran–Barshaini road, disrupting tourism, stranding travellers, and raising fresh concerns about Himalayan slope stability despite clear weather conditions.
